Explore Our Degrees
At UA Little Rock, the Donaghey College of Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics educates, inspires, and prepares undergraduates and graduate students for fulfilling internships and careers. Within the college there are five departments and two schools which offer academic programs at all levels – minors, undergraduate certificates and degrees, master’s certificates and degrees, and doctoral.
Our college is a key partner with industry, research, and education in the capital region of Little Rock, Arkansas. As a metropolitan university, UA Little Rock is positioned in a community that is innovative and collaborative with STEM professionals, which gives our students exciting and challenging research opportunities.
Here, we surround you with support, immerse you in experiences that shape you, and challenge you to go further. Contact us and explore our degrees and discover how you can own your future at UA Little Rock.
